Laureraz & Pelulu
King Elbano
Cannot go to another map during the battle!
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Repthon!!
Where's the teleporter you were talking about?\nThere's nothing here!
Wait! Look at that!!
I-i-isn't that C-Coenubia?!\nW-w-what do we do now?!
Let's just look for the teleporter first.\nLet's move and keep your distance from that thing!
By Deltzon Lufenas...I'm a fool who didn't end the\npointless battle and tried to wipe out a rival\ncountry at the cost of precious lives instead...
As a proof of my repentance, I'm leaving a device\nhere to protect and save people from crises that\nmay occur in Eldenbaum in the future...
My dear ancestor, perhaps you didn't make it to be\nused this way, but please allow me to use it for\nthe sake of the Darkan and Eldenbaum people!
But we haven't found the device yet...
Wow! What the hey! Guys, look at that!!
It seems to know about that machine too.\nI guess it was trying to control and get it to\nwork...
What?! What are these creatures!\nThe fact that they could be smarter than me\nkinda annoys me.
Let's beat this thing and get the device to work!
This device looks quite old though.\nI wonder if it works...
Let's have faith in my ancestor...Here we go!
Wow, wow, wow!! It's working!
I see, so one can move to a distant place through\nthat pillar of light...?
So,who wants to go first?
I-I'll pass...C-cuz even if the Cules can get\nthrough, it doesn't mean that the Elves or the\nHumes can get through too, right?
You're just a Straye. Besides, you've helped us\nso much. We can't depend on you too much!\nI'll go first!
Who's gonna lead us if you're gone?!\nSince I'm the vice-captain, I'll go instead!!
Umm...in this case...should I also be saying that\nI'll go instead of the vice-captain?
Yeah, yeah, go ahead!
Wow! I can't believe that you're not stopping me!!
I'll go...
Don't! We're already indebted to you for telling\nus about this device!
Or we can try sending some goods first...
This device was created by my ancestor...\nI guess it's only logical for his offspring to\ntry it out...
Hey, w-what happened to her?
Hey, hey, do you think Triet has teleported safely\nto El Scaro?
There's no way to know unless Triet comes back...
Triet!!
Woo-hoo!!\nGreat, the teleportation was a success!!
W-whaaaaat!! The King?!
K-king Elbano!!\nWhy did you come out of the...?!
The teleporter seems to be working properly...\nPerhaps this is what we call light at the end of\nthe tunnel...
Adventurer, sorry but could you go past\nGravel Terrace ASAP using this teleporter?
Whaaat?!
Whaaat?! Oh no, there's nothing more contagious\nthan the way he speaks...
But why now? We're so close to getting Eldenbaum\nback...
I'm fully aware of that too, but it's an\nemergency because a disaster is about to occur in\nEl Scaro!
In El Scaro?!\nWhat's going to happen?!
I got a report from the warriors who are guarding\nthe frontier zone that a powerful Coenubia had\nshowed up in the desert ahead of Gravel Terrace.
It's increasing the number of its minions and\nstarting to charge in the direction of El Scaro.
El Scaro's elite warriors and an acquaintance of\nyours, Balft, are heading there to attack back...
Balft?! He's in a place like that?!
Yes? What's wrong about it?
Uh, nothing...
That Coenubia probably intends to annihilate\nEl Scaro before we capture Eldenbaum back...
Recapturing Eldenbaum would be meaningless if all\nthe people who are supposed to return there get\nwiped out...
Besides, no one else knows how to fight Coenubia\nbetter than you...Although we have the teleporter,\nI'm fully aware that this is an absurd request...
But still, I'm compelled to request you to do it!\nWould you go to the desert ahead of\nGravel Terrace?
A nation is made up of people...The Elf people are\nso lucky to have a king who understands that...
It's true that it'd be a waste of effort to get\nEldenbaum back if no one is returning. It's kinda\ntiring and troublesome though, shall we...?
In that case, we'll go too...
No, no, no, no! You guys should go on with the\npreparation to recapture Eldenbaum!
Make sure we can go there once we get back here!!
Geez...you plan to go get Eldenbaum back as soon\nas you return from dealing with Coenubia?\nYou're so pumped...
Alright! We'll make sure everything's ready by the\ntime you get back. Just make sure you're ready to\ngo too by then!!
Sorry, regarding Balft though...
Could you please stop him...?
Hmm?
Actually, before King Elbano mentioned about him\nearlier, we haven't heard from him since he\nvanished from our sight...
What did you say?!
After the battle in Ultimea Palace, he did come\nback once, but he seemed depressed...
Oh...of course he did...\nRemember that farewell was very tough for him...
Yes...that's why I'm worried. I'm afraid that he's\nbecome too desperate and plans to give up on life\nafter losing many people who usually guide him...
So, if he does things that could get himself\nkilled during the battle, please stop him.
Okay. If that happens, we'll stop him\nno matter what!\nYou can count on us!!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing! Let's get out!
Explore here a little longer!
Nothing! Move to [ffff64]Gravel Terrace[ffffff]!!
